opening.title: One request. A clearer handover.
opening.subtitle: Follow one customer request from intake to a reviewed response.

benefits.title: Clearer decisions
benefits.detail: See what is known and missing

scenes.text: Follow one request to a reviewed response, with less searching and clear human control.
A customer needs an answer. The analyst opens the request to understand what happened and why it matters.
The analyst brings the available records together, so the team can see the facts without searching across separate screens.
The team compares possible answers. Missing information stays visible, rather than being replaced with an assumption. Any explanation still needs supporting evidence.
A person checks the proposed response and corrects it with a reason. The draft is support for the reviewer, not a decision made on their behalf.
The reviewed facts become a clear handover. Preparing or copying a response does not prove that it was sent, approved, or saved in another system.
If a fact changes, check whether the previous review is still valid. Show the real application behavior and explain who needs to review the change.
A clear handover, with human control.
